items.title: Audiotool 3.0 turns its multiplayer online DAW into an open platform for creator-built, AI-connected music tools
items.excerpt: Audiotool 3.0 rebuilds its browser DAW around NEXUS, an open-source SDK that lets musicians and developers build custom instruments, plugins and AI-connected tools inside the platform. The SDK supports MCP and Context I/O, so creators can wire their preferred LLMs directly into music-making.

items.title: Ocean Swift intros DevOcean Modular with MaYa, an AI agent that patches alongside you
items.excerpt: Ocean Swift's DevOcean Modular is a 145-module software synthesis and sound-design environment whose standout is MaYa, a modular AI agent that builds and patches modular setups collaboratively alongside the user rather than just auto-generating a result.
